project.description: Name of the application the library is wired into. Without it the workspace must have exactly one application.

themes.description: Register zenit-ui/styles/themes.css and wire the theme without a flash: init script in index.html, provideZenitTheme() in the application config, inlineCritical off for production.
themes.x-prompt: Set up the colour schemes (theme stylesheet, init script, provideZenitTheme)?

fonts.description: Add the self-hosted fonts (Material Icons, Inter, Space Grotesk, JetBrains Mono).

toastOutlet.x-prompt: Mount the toast outlet in the root component?
